s.g: (by extension) (video games, in a visual novel) A unique, static full-screen image, usually displayed to illustrate a significant event in the story.
(US, military, nautical) A guided missile cruiser.

cg.f: (visual effects, animation) Initialism of computer graphics.

cga.f: (countable, Canada) Initialism of certified general accountant.

cgb.f: (uncountable, astronomy, cosmology, astrophysics) Initialism of cosmic gravitational-wave background.

cgc.f: (physics) Abbreviation of color glass condensate/colour glass condensate.

cgi.f: (visual effects, animation) Initialism of Computer-Generated Imagery.

s.g: (transitive, informal) To create visuals using computer-generated imagery; to apply visual effects.
s.x: When a Transformer turns into a car, do you think it's a real car or was it also CGIed?

cgs.f: (physics) Initialism of centimetre-gram-second: a system of measurement taking these as its fundamental units, now replaced by the SI system.
